d:
Jensen Huang resigned as CEO of tech giant, Nvidia. His resignation is effective immediately and comes after reports that he had an extramarital affair with a woman that U.S. intelligence alleges is a Chinese spy.
Also in focus: Two missing Special Police Officers were found dead with bullet wounds in Jammu and Kashmir’s Kishtwar; Asaduddin Owaisi and Chandrashekhar Azad launched a new political front ahead of the 2027 Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections; and Norwegian journalist Helle Lyng alleged she was barred from travelling to Hyderabad for the Bharat Summit.
